# Tasks Document
Document version: v3

This spec adds one `harness` tool (`orient`, `brief`, `phase-log`), moves the two spawn-boundary events onto the plugin hook, adds an orchestrator `spawn.usage` event the `--watch` renderer joins, and edits every SDD skill so the orchestrators only route. Dependency order: task 1 adds the parser export tasks 2 and 3 need; task 2 registers the tool with `brief`/`phase-log` returning a not-implemented bridge that tasks 3 and 4 remove; tasks 5 and 6 are build-independent — task 6 handles the events task 5 writes; task 7 rewrites the skills and task 8 the tool-count doc last. Each code task leaves the tree compiling and every existing suite green, because each new action, event or export is additive and the old `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` path is left untouched; tasks 7 and 8 change only skills and docs and are verified by their sync, schema and grep checks, not an existing suite.

- [ ] 1. Add `taskBlock` export to the tasks parser
  - File: src/core/task-parser.ts
  - File: src/core/__tests__/task-parser-progress.test.ts
  - Add `taskBlock(content, taskId)` returning the checkbox-to-next-checkbox slice, joined with newlines, using the same `checkboxIndices` bounds (src/core/task-parser.ts:164-176) the parser uses.
  - Purpose: give `brief` a byte-exact task block (design Component 3, D5; Requirement 2.2).
  - _Leverage: src/core/task-parser.ts:153-356_
  - _Requirements: 2.2_
  - _Prompt: Task: Add a `taskBlock(content, taskId)` export to src/core/task-parser.ts that returns `lines.slice(lineNumber, endLine).join('\n')` for the task whose id matches, reusing the same `checkboxIndices` bounds (src/core/task-parser.ts:164-176) the parser computes, and returns undefined for an unknown id | Restrictions: Do not change `parseTasksFromMarkdown` (src/core/task-parser.ts:153) or `parseTaskProgress` (src/core/task-parser.ts:420); the block runs to the next checkbox, so an intervening `##` heading is included (requirements Scope notes); add a unit test to src/core/__tests__/task-parser-progress.test.ts, which today asserts only on `parseTaskProgress`, so leave its existing assertions unchanged | Success: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; `npx vitest run src/core/__tests__/task-parser-progress.test.ts` is green; the returned slice equals the parser's block for a task byte for byte_

- [ ] 2. Add the `harness` tool shell and the `orient` action
  - File: src/tools/harness.ts
  - File: src/tools/index.ts
  - File: src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts
  - Create `harnessTool`/`harnessHandler`, register in the array (src/tools/index.ts:17-33) and the dispatch switch (src/tools/index.ts:35-96); implement `orient`, with `brief` and `phase-log` returning a not-implemented `success:false` bridge tasks 3 and 4 remove.
  - Purpose: one tool, three actions; `orient` returns the Step 0 state and next step (Requirement 1).
  - _Leverage: src/tools/spec-index.ts:13-131, src/tools/spec-status.ts:69-79, src/core/spec-status-deriver.ts:17-37, src/core/approval-records.ts:98-121, src/tools/root-selection.ts:202-221, src/tools/spec-lint.ts:79-90_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7_
  - _Prompt: Task: Add src/tools/harness.ts exporting `harnessTool` (inputSchema per design Component 1: `action` one of orient/brief/phase-log, `specName`, optional `phase`, `mode`, `template`, `values`, `taskId`, `projectPath`; required action and specName; readOnlyHint false) and `harnessHandler`, and register both in src/tools/index.ts (array 17-33, switch 35-96). Resolve roots with `selectRoots` and read the spec dir through `PathUtils.getSpecPath`/`safeJoin` as src/tools/spec-lint.ts:79-90. Implement the `orient` action for the five routing phases per design Component 2 and its Data Model: for document phases derive D, A, verdict, P, narrowCheck and nextStep; for implementation the task counts via `parseTasksFromMarkdown` (src/core/task-parser.ts:153); for closeout the items and byClass; take approval and phase state from `deriveSpecStatus` plus `deriveDocumentApprovalStates` (src/tools/spec-status.ts:69-79), not re-derived (1.6). Make the `brief` and `phase-log` branches return `success:false` naming the action as not yet implemented, a bridge tasks 3 and 4 remove | Restrictions: Spawn no child process; do not re-implement approval derivation; no existing test asserts the registered-tool count, so registration breaks nothing | Success: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; a new src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts asserts `orient` returns the skill-chosen nextStep for the six fixture states (1.7); `npx vitest run src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts` is green_

- [ ] 3. Implement the `brief` action
  - File: src/tools/harness.ts
  - File: src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts
  - Fill a named server template's `{{key}}` placeholders from `values`, write the read-and-obey first line when agent-rules.md exists at the spec-store root, fill the implementer task-block placeholder via the `taskBlock` task 1 exports, write the file and return its path; remove task 2's `brief` bridge.
  - Purpose: the server writes a worker brief from a template (Requirement 2).
  - _Leverage: src/core/task-parser.ts:153-356, harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/references/briefs.md:4-11_
  - _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4_
  - _Prompt: Task: Implement the harness `brief` action in src/tools/harness.ts per design Component 3: hold the named server templates the five brief kinds need, registering each under a stable `template` name that task 7's `brief` calls pass verbatim, fill each `{{key}}` placeholder from `values`, and when the template is the implementer brief with a `taskId` fill the task-block placeholder with the block the `taskBlock` export task 1 adds, so it equals the parser's block byte for byte (2.2). Write the first line as an instruction to read and obey the agent-rules.md path when that file exists at the spec-store root, per harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/references/briefs.md:4-11 (2.4). Write the file through `PathUtils.safeJoin` (src/core/path-utils.ts:183-206) under the caller-named path and return its absolute path; remove task 2's `brief` not-implemented bridge | Restrictions: A missing required value or an unknown template returns `success:false` naming it and writes no file (2.3); do not port references/briefs.md into the server or add a sync guard, which design Scope notes defer | Success: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; harness.test.ts asserts `brief` writes task 3's block byte for byte and fails naming a missing value; `npx vitest run src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts` is green_

- [ ] 4. Implement the `phase-log` action
  - File: src/tools/harness.ts
  - File: src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts

  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.3, 5.4_
  - _Prompt: Task: Implement the harness `phase-log` action in src/tools/harness.ts per design Component 4: read HANDOFF via `handoffPath` (src/watch/index.ts:35-39) and the spec's harness-events.jsonl, then rewrite only the `## Phase log` block using the row shape at harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:52-67, modeled on the deterministic re-serialize in src/core/index-generator.ts:159-211. Preserve verbatim the rows whose `Spec` cell is another spec (src/watch/ledger.ts:145-157) and leave the routing header and the per-spec `## spec — stage` sections untouched. Add a row for each `phase.end` that no existing row holds (dedup as src/watch/ledger.ts:209-211), keep a pre-ledger hand-written row that has no matching `phase.end` (5.3), and for a `phase.start` with no `phase.end` that is not the live phase — run.end present or a prior run (src/watch/ledger.ts:216-224) — emit a row with Result `interrupted` and its entry-snapshot state (5.4); remove task 2's `phase-log` not-implemented bridge | Restrictions: Write only the `## Phase log` block; touch no other section and no other spec's rows; never stamp a live phase `interrupted` | Success: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; harness.test.ts asserts another spec's rows survive and an unclosed not-live phase yields an `interrupted` row; `npx vitest run src/tools/__tests__/harness.test.ts` is green_

- [ ] 5. Write `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` from the plugin hook
  - File: harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh
  - File: src/__tests__/hook-spawn-events.test.ts
  - On an Agent-tool `PreToolUse` naming an `sdd-*` subagent with a brief path, append a `spawn.start` LedgerEvent to harness-events.jsonl; on `SubagentStop` of a non-orchestrator `sdd-*` agent append a `spawn.end`; keep the existing activity writes unchanged; regenerate plugins/.
  - Purpose: the hooks write the two spawn-boundary events (Requirement 3).
  - _Leverage: harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:11-67, harness/hooks/hooks.json:4-38, src/watch/ledger.ts:14-20_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.7_
  - _Prompt: Task: Extend harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh per design Component 5 so it keeps appending its tool/agent.start/agent.stop ActivityEvent lines to harness-activity.jsonl unchanged (3.7) and additionally: on a `PreToolUse` (harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:44-67) whose `tool_input.subagent_type` is an `sdd-*` agent (last segment after a colon) and whose `tool_input.prompt` contains a brief path, appends a LedgerEvent `{ ts, type: spawn.start, run, spec, agent, role }` to harness-events.jsonl with spec the spec-dir basename and role the brief-filename stem before `-brief`; and on `SubagentStop` of an `sdd-*` agent whose type does not end in `-orchestrator`, appends `{ ts, type: spawn.end, run, spec, agent }`. Write nothing without a matching pointer line or for a non-`sdd-*` agent (3.4). Then run `node scripts/sync-plugin-assets.cjs` and commit the plugins/ copies in the same commit | Restrictions: harness/hooks/ is a sensitive path — keep the pointer and SPEC_DIR resolution (harness/hooks/sdd-activity.sh:11-29) and the existing activity writes intact; the integration test asserts only on `fs.appendFileSync` output the node 20 docs guarantee (agent-rules.md); never hand-edit plugins/ | Success: a node test at src/__tests__/hook-spawn-events.test.ts drives the script with a fake `PreToolUse` payload and a pointer file and finds one spawn.start line, and a `SubagentStop` payload finds one spawn.end; `npm run check:plugin-assets` and `claude plugin validate . --strict` pass_

- [ ] 6. Add `spawn.usage`, the buildModel join, and the ticker branch
  - File: src/watch/ledger.ts
  - File: src/watch/render.ts
  - File: src/watch/__tests__/ledger.test.ts
  - File: src/watch/__tests__/render.test.ts
  - Fold each `spawn.usage` onto the nearest earlier unconsumed same-agent spawn (synthesizing a node when none is unconsumed), coerce the token count, and add a `spawn.usage` ticker branch; leave the old spawn-pairing path unchanged.
  - Purpose: join the orchestrator usage event per spawn and keep old ledgers identical (Requirements 3.5, 4).
  - _Leverage: src/watch/ledger.ts:226-248, src/watch/ledger.ts:273, src/watch/ledger.ts:296-315, src/watch/render.ts:180-208_
  - _Requirements: 3.5, 4.1, 4.2_
  - _Prompt: Task: In src/watch/ledger.ts, per design Component 6, add a pass after the spawn-pairing loop (src/watch/ledger.ts:226-248) that folds each `spawn.usage` event, in ts order, onto the nearest earlier SpawnNode of the same agent that no earlier `spawn.usage` has claimed — a once-only unconsumed match, like the `!s.endedAt` one-time pairing at src/watch/ledger.ts:241 — coercing `Number(tokens)` and setting role, result, tokens, phase, task and round. When no unconsumed same-agent node exists (a prompt-launched worker, a reused-agent worker whose earlier brief node is already claimed, or a dropped spawn.start), synthesize a level-2 SpawnNode with startedAt and endedAt both the usage ts so src/watch/render.ts:180-208 renders it and tokensTotal (src/watch/ledger.ts:273) sums it. Add a `spawn.usage` ticker branch mirroring src/watch/ledger.ts:300-301 so the ticker keeps the precise role, result and tokens (4.2). Consume the `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` the hook task 5 writes | Restrictions: Leave the pairing loop and the old spawn.start/spawn.end path unchanged so an old ledger renders identically (4.1); extend src/watch/__tests__/ledger.test.ts and render.test.ts with new cases only and alter no value their existing tests assert | Success: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean; new tests cover the `spawn.usage` join, a reused-agent prompt-launched worker getting its own synthesized node and tokens, and an old ledger rendering unchanged; `npx vitest run src/watch/__tests__/ledger.test.ts src/watch/__tests__/render.test.ts` is green_

- [ ] 7. Rewrite the skills, budgets and event contract
  - File: harness/skills/sdd-document-phase/SKILL.md
  - File: harness/skills/sdd-implementation-phase/SKILL.md
  - File: harness/skills/sdd-closeout-phase/SKILL.md
  - File: harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md

  - Replace manual Step 0 with `orient` and manual brief writes with `brief`, drop worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end`, keep the routing events plus one `spawn.usage` per spawn, make sdd-continue call `phase-log` instead of hand-writing rows, add the `spawn.usage` row to formats.md, and state the reduced-context budgets; regenerate plugins/.
  - Purpose: the orchestrators route only (Requirements 3.3, 3.6, 5.2, 6).
  - _Leverage: harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:185-198, harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:139-143, harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:173, harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:180-183, harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:187-193_
  - _Requirements: 3.3, 3.6, 5.2, 6.1, 6.2_
  - _Prompt: Task: Edit the four SDD skills and formats.md per design Component 7: in sdd-document-phase, sdd-implementation-phase and sdd-closeout-phase replace the manual Step 0 with the `orient` action and manual brief assembly with the `brief` action the harness tool tasks 2 to 4 add, drop worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end`, and keep `round`, `task.pick`, `task.done`, `note`, `phase.*` (harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md:185-197) plus one `spawn.usage` (the event task 6 defines) per spawn. In sdd-continue stop hand-writing `## Phase log` rows at both sites Requirement 5.2 names — the State-row-ahead interrupted write (harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:139-143) and the per-`PHASE:`-result `write one HANDOFF phase row` writes (harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:187-193) — and call the `phase-log` action for both, keeping only the supervisor's orchestrator `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` (harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:180-183). Add the `spawn.usage` row to the event table in harness/skills/sdd-continue/references/formats.md and mark worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` hook-written. Keep the implementation BUDGET at 20 tasks and close-out at all items (harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:173) and add a sentence to each that the budget assumes the reduced context (6.1, 6.2). Run `node scripts/sync-plugin-assets.cjs` and commit plugins/ | Restrictions: harness/ is a sensitive path — do not name a call signature, action name or event key that tasks 2 to 6 own beyond what design Component 7 fixes; never hand-edit plugins/; task 7 (skills stop writing worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end`) and task 5 (hook starts writing them) must land in the same PR so no transient double-write window ships | Success: `npm run check:plugin-assets` and `claude plugin validate . --strict` pass, and every per-skill grep done-condition holds: in sdd-document-phase, sdd-implementation-phase and sdd-closeout-phase `grep -n 'spawn\.start\|spawn\.end' <skill>` shows no worker spawn-boundary write (the edit that must exactly complement task 5's hook — only `spawn.usage` remains), and each shows a `harness orient` call in place of the manual Step 0 and a `harness brief` call in place of manual brief assembly whose `template` value is one task 3 registered (list task 3's template names and grep each `brief` call against them); in sdd-continue a `harness phase-log` call replaces the hand-written `## Phase log` rows at both harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:139-143 and :187-193 — `grep -n 'write one HANDOFF phase row\|write the missing phase-log row' harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md` returns nothing, so no `approved`/`complete`/`closed` per-result write (:187, :189) and no State-row-ahead interrupted write (:142) survives, and the `resume` result (:192-193) likewise routes to `phase-log` rather than a hand row (leave the `escalate`/`design-defect`/`verify-failed` HANDOFF-row writes at :194-202, which Requirement 5.2 does not name, untouched) — while the supervisor's orchestrator `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` (harness/skills/sdd-continue/SKILL.md:180-183) remain; formats.md shows the added `spawn.usage` row and marks worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` hook-written; and each of the implementation and close-out budgets carries the reduced-context sentence_

- [ ] 8. Update the tool count in the tools reference
  - File: docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md
  - Change the registered-tool count word to 14 and add a `harness` row to the tool index table.
  - Purpose: the docs match the new registered tool (design converged MINOR).
  - _Requirements: 1.1_
  - _Prompt: Task: In docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md change the tool count word to 14 (docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md:5) and add a `harness` row to the tool index table (docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md:20-34) summarizing the orient, brief and phase-log actions; run `grep -n "tools" docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md` to find every place the count is stated and update each, leaving the MCP-prompt count unchanged | Restrictions: Docs only; do not touch code or the prompt count | Success: `grep -n "14 tools" docs/TOOLS-REFERENCE.md` matches and the tool index table lists the harness tool_

## Decisions taken in this document

- D1 — Stage the tool's actions with a not-implemented bridge: options were building all three actions in one task or staging them; chosen staged so each task leaves the tree compiling and every suite green, per the ordering rule.
- D2 — The `taskBlock` unit test lives in src/core/__tests__/task-parser-progress.test.ts: options were a new test file or the existing parser test; chosen the existing file because `taskBlock` is a parser export and it keeps the module's tests together.
- D3 — The hook integration test is a node test at src/__tests__/: options were a shell test harness or a node driver; chosen node so it asserts on JSON-line fields node 20 guarantees, per agent-rules.md.
- D4 — All skill, budget and formats edits are one task: options were one task per skill or one combined task; chosen combined because they share the sync-plugin-assets step and the one event-contract change and none compiles code.
- D5 — The tool-count doc is its own task: options were folding it into task 2 or a separate task; chosen separate so the count-word rule (agent-rules.md, Documents) is a discrete, greppable change.

## Scope notes

- No `steering/structure.md` exists (the directory is empty), so the brief's step-1 steering load was skipped; scope is taken from decomposition entry 6 and this spec's requirements and design.
- Retrospective `orient` is out of v1, carried from requirements and design D4: the retrospective Step 0 is a preconditions check, not one of the entry's five verification states.
- Porting the skills' references/briefs.md into the server template set and adding a sync guard is deferred (design D2 and Scope notes); task 3 ships only the named templates the five brief kinds need — design D2's v1 template set, a different axis from Component 5's seven hook-detected brief-launched workers — and task 7 passes each `brief` call a `template` name from task 3's set.
- The implementer task block now runs to the next checkbox and so includes an intervening `##` heading, the intended change carried from requirements Scope notes.
- Coverage: the seven design components map to tasks 2 (Component 1), 2 (Component 2), 3 (Component 3), 4 (Component 4), 5 (Component 5), 6 (Component 6) and 7 (Component 7); task 1 adds the parser export Component 3 needs. Both converged MINORs are covered — the reused-agent render/ledger case in task 6 and the tool-count doc in task 8.

## Revision History
- **v3** (2026-09-15) — Round-2 adversarial response (adversarial-analysis-tasks-r2.md, verdict iterate 0/1/0), SHOULD_FIX-only corrective pass.
  - **R2-1 — Accepted (SHOULD_FIX).** Requirement 5.2 names two supervisor phase-log write sites — the State-row-ahead interrupted write and the per-`PHASE:`-result writes — but task 7 retired only the first. Extended task 7's removal instruction and grep done-condition to the per-`PHASE:`-result writes, split the leverage/keep citation between the orchestrator spawn write (kept) and the per-`PHASE:`-result write (retired), and scoped the grep to the precise in-scope phrases so the out-of-scope `escalate`/`design-defect`/`verify-failed` rows are left as Requirement 5.2 pins them. No call signature changed, so no design amendment.
  - **Lint pass.** 7 fixed; rejected: L-1..L-26 each names an artefact this spec creates (the `harness` tool/handler, its `orient`/`brief`/`phase-log` actions and schema fields, `taskBlock`, `interrupted`, `escalate`, the newly-read `tool_input.prompt`, the added `harness` doc row) cited at the anchor its new code attaches to. L-27..L-33 rewrote the R2-1 bullet's bare `SKILL.md:<range>` citations to prose, so the Revision History bullet no longer reads as citations.
- **v2** (2026-09-15) — Round-1 adversarial response (adversarial-analysis-tasks.md, verdict iterate 0/2/1).
  - **R1-1 — Partially accepted (SHOULD_FIX).** Pinned the producer/consumer contract: task 3 registers each template under a stable `template` name and task 7 passes each `brief` call a name from that set (checked by a grep done-condition), closing the runtime `success:false` risk. Rejected the "reconcile five vs seven" part: Component 5's seven brief-launched workers are the hook-detection axis (spawn.start on a brief path), distinct from design D2's five-template v1 set — not a contradiction; noted that distinction in the Scope note.
  - **R1-2 — Accepted (SHOULD_FIX).** Kept task 7 combined (D4 closed) but gave it per-skill grep done-conditions so a partial edit fails: each phase skill shows no worker `spawn.start`/`spawn.end` (the edit that must complement task 5), an `orient`/`brief` call in place of the manual paths; sdd-continue calls `phase-log` and keeps the orchestrator spawns; formats.md carries the `spawn.usage` row; both budgets carry the reduced-context sentence. Added a release-together guard binding task 7 and task 5 to one PR so no double-write window ships.
  - **R1-3 — Accepted (MINOR).** Reworded the intro: tasks 5 and 6 are "build-independent — task 6 handles the events task 5 writes," and the compile/suite claim now scopes tasks 7 and 8 to their sync, schema and grep checks.
  - **Lint pass.** 12 fixed; rejected: L-1..L-24, L-26 each names a created artefact (the `harness` tool/handler, its actions and schema fields, `taskBlock`, `interrupted`, the newly-read `tool_input.prompt`, the added `harness` doc row) cited at the anchor its new code attaches to. L-25 gave the one bare `SKILL.md` citation on the task 7 prompt its full spec-relative path; L-27..L-37 trimmed the v1 Lint-pass bullet's packed citation list to prose so it no longer reads as citations.
- **v1** (2026-09-15) — Initial draft.
  - **Lint pass.** 11 fixed: named design Component 6 in task 6 for coverage; reworded the bounds clause to `the parser`; cited the existing parser exports, the `safeJoin` join, the hook seam and the event table by their anchors. Rejected the created-artefact identifiers — the harness tool, handler, its actions and schema fields, `taskBlock`, the `interrupted` Result value, the newly-read `tool_input.prompt`, the `spawn.usage` segment and task 8's `harness` row — each cited at the anchor its new code attaches to.
